facts.fact: Good TTFB is 0.8 seconds or less
Poor TTFB is more than 1.8 seconds
DevTools shows "Waiting for server response" under Network, Timing

source.ref: Chrome DevTools Network panel documentation, not read yet

facts.fact: TTFB is not one of the three Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS)

source.ref: web.dev Core Web Vitals page, not read yet

facts.fact: A CDN that serves only static files does not lower page TTFB; full-page caching can

source.ref: a CDN vendor's documentation, not read yet

facts.fact: Newer supported PHP versions usually run WordPress faster

source.ref: php.net or WordPress documentation, not read yet

facts.fact: Query Monitor is a plugin that shows slow queries

source.ref: wordpress.org plugin page, not read yet
